title: Quit India Speech ('Do or Die'), Bombay, 8 August 1942

publication.publisher_or_container: Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi (Publications Division, Government of India); delivered at Gowalia Tank Maidan, Bombay

access.locator: Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi, Publications Division, Government of India; Gandhi Heritage Portal (gandhiheritageportal.org).

verification.verification_notes: Historic fact of the speech, its date (8 August 1942) and the 'Do or Die' call were verified against a reference summary of the Quit India Movement. The full text was not inspected in this pass; the speech is cited as a documented exemplar of time-pressed anti-colonial address, not quoted.

limitations: The event and phrase are documented; exact wording and delivery nuance in the original Gujarati/Hindi are not verified here.

copyright.notes: Jurisdiction-scoped, not blanket: Gandhi's works are public domain in India, and that is the only jurisdiction verified in this pass; the term elsewhere was not determined, so no repository-wide copy permission is asserted. Cited as a documented exemplar; no passage reproduced.
